summary: A daemon restart no longer rechecks every message sent since the previous start

replay.detail: No graph replay or projection change. Coordination counts hold the same values.

schema.detail: No database, registry or wire change. The existing coordination backfill ceiling now advances with sends the live projection synced.

compatibility.detail: No client, peer or harness contract change. Sends an older binary wrote are still above the ceiling and are still rechecked on the next open.

downtime.detail: Shorter: after a restart the coordination count bootstrap no longer takes one background writer page per eight messages sent since the previous start (244 pages on hetz2 at a 21:50Z restart) while every seat reconnects. The first restart into this binary still rechecks the tail once.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the recheck on every open.
